name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport was somewhat accidental, sparked by a chance encounter with a former F1 mechanic while studying business administration in Valencia. Intrigued, he shifted his focus to sports management, eventually landing an internship with a regional racing team. He quickly discovered a talent for human resources, recognizing the importance of team cohesion and individual well-being in a high-pressure environment. Ricardo is known for his meticulous approach to talent acquisition and development, always seeking to foster a supportive and challenging atmosphere within the team. He believes that a team's greatest asset is its people, and strives to create a culture of continuous improvement and mutual respect.

His experience at Caterham Academy has been especially rewarding, allowing him to shape the careers of young drivers and contribute to the team's long-term success. He's particularly proud of implementing a mentorship program that pairs experienced staff with new recruits, ensuring a smooth transition and fostering a sense of belonging. Ricardo is driven by a desire to optimize team performance through effective human resources practices, making him a valuable asset to any motorsport organization.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is a man of medium height with a strong build and a confident demeanor.

quirks: Insists on a team-building activity every quarter, no matter how busy the schedule.
Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations about team dynamics.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought, which can sometimes distract others.
